questions.question: According to these lecture notes, list the four necessary conditions for deadlock. Keep the answer under 70 words.
questions.answer: The four necessary conditions for a deadlock are: mutual exclusion, hold‑and‑wait, no‑preemption, and circular‑wait.

questions.question: According to this uploaded syllabus, on which day and at what times are office hours, and where are they held? Keep the answer under 45 words.
questions.answer: Office hours are on Wednesdays from 7:30 PM to 9:30 PM, held online via Blackboard.

questions.question: According to the lecture notes, does a directed cycle always prove deadlock? Explain the difference for one instance versus multiple instances per resource type. Keep it under 65 words.
questions.answer: A directed cycle guarantees deadlock only when each resource type has a single instance; then a cycle means each process waits indefinitely. With multiple instances per resource, a cycle may exist without deadlock because enough instances might satisfy pending requests. [S2]
